palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed light green body, pink-yellow flower, orange sprout, green-purple vine tips, source eyes and dark outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr348 mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded with fixed row-47 shadow. Preserve native lift and recoil; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own alternating feet, vine-arm and flower sway; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward vine-arm strike and recovery; Physical Attack remains untrimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own raised-vine open-mouth release gesture; no invented projectile or glow.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own curled flower-and-vine resting loop; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary backward recoil. Prone bd02/bd03 knockdowns remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own signature long-vine sweep; no synthetic weapon and no shortened anatomy.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the own vine strike; one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own compact crouch-and-rise motion; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced vine-and-flower charge with reverse-sampled recovery; no aura.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
